# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged to elderly
- **Gender:** Female
- **Status:** Alive
- **Rank:** Prominent community figure
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Homemaker, community organizer, and busybody
- **Titles:** Mrs.

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a notable, bustling woman who manages her household and community affairs with formidable efficiency. She has a sharp, keen eye that misses little of what happens in Avonlea. Despite her blunt exterior, her appearance reflects her practical, industrious nature and solid standing in the neighborhood.

## Personality

Rachel is outspoken, opinionated, and highly inquisitive, infamous for her blunt speech and sharp judgments. Beneath her bossy and busybody demeanor lies a kind-hearted, well-meaning, and fiercely loyal neighbor. She takes great pride in her domestic duties, church work, and knowledge of everyone's business. Though quick to criticize, she is equally quick to offer practical help and warm support in times of need.

## Traits

- Outspoken and blunt
- Industrious and capable
- Opinionated and judgmental
- Kind-hearted and charitable

## Abilities

- Exceptional practical household management
- Expert knitting and handiwork
- Community organizing and church leadership

## Goals

- To keep order and propriety in Avonlea social and church life
- To help her neighbors and provide practical guidance to those around her

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is the primary source of news and gossip in Avonlea, living at Lynde's Hollow near Green Gables. When Matthew Cuthbert unexpectedly sets off to adopt a boy, Rachel is the first to notice and question Marilla about it. She is shocked when Anne Shirley arrives instead, and upon meeting Anne, she bluntly criticizes her appearance, provoking Anne into an explosive temper tantrum. After Marilla insists Anne apologize, Rachel graciously accepts the apology and quickly becomes one of Anne's staunch supporters. Over the next few years, Rachel watches Anne grow into a young woman, offering continuous advice and practical assistance to Green Gables. When Matthew dies, Rachel comforts Marilla and helps support the household. Later, when Rachel's mild husband Thomas falls ill and passes away, Rachel decides to move in with Marilla Cuthbert at Green Gables, uniting the two long-time friends under one roof and allowing Anne to pursue her studies at Redmond College.

## Background by volume

- Raised ten children at Lynde's Hollow
- Longtime neighbor and close friend to Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert
- Pillar of the Avonlea Church Ladies' Aid Society and local Temperance work

## Affiliations

- Avonlea Church Ladies' Aid Society — Prominent member and organizer
- Avonlea Village Improvement Society — Member and advisor
